properties.description: Attractive three bedroom semi-detached family home situated within 0.5 miles of Petts Wood station with fast trains to London and within easy walking distance of local shops, schools, bus routes and National Trust woodland. The property comprises; two receptions, fitted 18'9 x 10'1 kitchen/breakfast room and conservatory. The property also benefits from having a utility room and cloakroom. To the first floor there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom with separate WC. Additional features include double glazing, gas central heating and a well presented interior...
properties.location: Petts Wood Road, Petts Wood, Orpington BR5

properties.description:
Presented in excellent decorative order throughout is this two double bedroom, two bathroom, garden flat.
The modern fitted kitchen is open plan to the living room which boasts solid wooden floors and includes integrated appliances including a dishwasher & a washing machine. This large open plan benefits from bi folding doors onto a secluded private courtyard garden. Both bedrooms are double sized, and the family bathroom boasts a matching three piece suite a shower attachment over the bath. There is also a separate wet room. There are walnut doors throughout and wiring for Sky TV/aerial points in the living room/kitchen and both bedrooms.
This apartment being only five years old, is still under a 10 year building guarantee...

Spacious four bedroom detached family home situated within a quiet and sought-after residential location.
This well-proportioned property offers generous living accommodation including a large open-plan kitchen/dining area, multiple reception spaces, and modern interiors finished to a high standard throughout. The property further benefits from ample storage, quality flooring, and abundant natural light.
Upstairs comprises four well-sized bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with fitted wardrobes, and a contemporary family bathroom. Externally, the property features a private rear garden ideal for family living and entertaining, as well as off-street parking and a garage. Additional features include double glazing, gas central heating, and excellent access to local schools, transport links, and amenities.

Modern one bedroom apartment ideally positioned within the heart of Bromley town centre, offering excellent access to shops, restaurants, and transport links.
The accommodation comprises a bright open-plan living and dining area with a contemporary fitted kitchen, providing a comfortable and practical living space. Large windows allow for plenty of natural light, enhancing the sense of space throughout the apartment.
The bedroom is well-proportioned and benefits from built-in storage, while the bathroom is finished with a modern suite and quality fittings. Further advantages include secure entry, lift access, and proximity to Bromley South station, making this an ideal first-time purchase or investment opportunity.

Well-maintained two bedroom bungalow set within a quiet residential street, offering convenient single-level living and excellent outdoor space.
The property features a spacious living room, a modern fitted kitchen with ample storage, and two comfortable bedrooms suited for a range of buyers. The accommodation is thoughtfully laid out to maximise space and practicality.
Externally, the bungalow benefits from both front and rear gardens, providing ideal areas for relaxation and gardening. Additional features include off-street parking, double glazing, gas central heating, and close proximity to local shops, transport routes, and amenities.

Impressive five bedroom detached family residence offering substantial living space and premium finishes throughout.
This exceptional property provides multiple reception rooms, a high-specification kitchen, and flexible accommodation suitable for modern family life. Large windows and well-planned layouts ensure bright and airy interiors across all floors.
The first floor comprises five generously sized bedrooms, including a principal suite, alongside modern bathrooms finished to a high standard. Outside, the property boasts a landscaped rear garden, ideal for entertaining, as well as ample off-street parking. Situated within a highly regarded school catchment area, the home also benefits from excellent transport links and nearby green spaces.

Three bedroom penthouse apartment offering spacious accommodation and impressive panoramic views across the surrounding area.
The property features a large open-plan living and dining space with access to private outdoor areas, creating an ideal environment for entertaining. The modern fitted kitchen is complemented by quality finishes and integrated appliances.
All three bedrooms are well-sized, with the principal bedroom benefiting from fitted storage. Additional advantages include lift access, secure underground parking, and excellent proximity to Lewisham station, providing fast connections into central London.

Charming three bedroom period property retaining a wealth of original features while benefiting from modern enhancements throughout.
The accommodation comprises a welcoming living space, extended kitchen and dining area, and thoughtfully designed interiors that blend character with contemporary living. The layout offers flexibility suitable for family life or entertaining.
Upstairs provides three well-proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom. Externally, the property enjoys a private rear garden and convenient access to local parks, schools, and transport links. Additional benefits include gas central heating, double glazing, and a highly desirable residential location.
